text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I clock Nakayama Festa's time
as she runs on the beach.
Her abilities have clearly improved over this camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time, isn't it?
For the race of the girl who won the Oaks.
She traveled all the way to Sapporo for this, right?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She's the undisputed favorite, apparently.
And if she wins today's race,
next up is the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
If it's her, bringing home Japan's long-coveted trophy
isn't just a pipe dream...!
choice_data_list: (...Everyone around is talking exclusively about another girl.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The throne I wanted Nakayama Festa to claim.
Sitting upon it was another Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A long-cherished dream for Japan.
The hope of a maiden victory in the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the stage of the bet she made
with Sensei, the voices calling out in
anticipation of her arrival are now gone—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ORA ORAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, let's do this! Nakayama!
We're gonna go take down that Kyoto crayfish, right!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna borrow the Golshi Cannon, let's make a deal!
Go fetch me some melon-flavored shaved ice right this second!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Then if I win the tandem run,
you owe me strawberry ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aah, no fair!
Golshi-chan wants that one too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and Gold Ship steadily
prepare to run in tandem.
Even though that was never on the schedule...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer. Hurry it up.
Decide which course I'm running
while Golshi's still in the mood.
choice_data_list: Then let's do the beach to build up strength!
On a trek that will test your guts,

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then it's a crab walk showdown!
Here I gooo! Nakayamaaa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi! False start!
Crabs ain't allowed to fly, that's the rule!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoopsie☆ My bad, my bad!
Then let's run side-by-side☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hyoo. Delicious!!
You've got good taste, bastard!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainking?
Does that mean you're the king of Trainers?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's right. And that makes me the Umamusume King,
ruling over all Kings.
Now, Golshi, think you can take me down?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! Yes. I. Caaan!
Let's do this, Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hyoo. Delicious!!
You've got good taste, bastard!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, the tandem workout went smoothly.
...Almost as if it had been planned all along."
choice_data_list: Did I forget a promise to run together...?
Did I forget our promise to run together...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell it was.
Just a coincidence. Totally on a whim."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Golshi excels at long distances, though.
Running side-by-side with her now will pay off in the Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: Could you invite Gold Ship, then?
Then why don't you invite Gold Ship?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, more like I invited them, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Another strawberry ice cream, please!!
Oh, and pack fifty yakisoba to go too!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—It'd probably be more accurate to say
she just dropped by on a whim to hang out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“...... Jeez, Golshi... how long are you
gonna keep messing around with Nakayama...!”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: If you're here, we can't have a serious talk—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no way...
There's no way... I can believe that...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, what's with you?
You let out this huge scream all of a sudden. What's up?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? The Guy-say-mon?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I heard that Oaks-winning Umamusume
is passing on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That news was earth-shattering.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... The media was like a funeral, too.
Saying how it was a glimmer of hope they finally had, and all.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If the call is made that she can't win,
the other Umamusume would probably scratch from the race too.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Is the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe truly an unreachable,
eternal dream for Japanese Umamusume after all?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
mind if I go for a quick run?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go get some fresh air.
Yeah, let's go get some fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Slipping away from the camp lodge wrapped in heavy air,
I watch over Nakayama Festa as she runs in silence."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Following the withdrawal of the leading candidate for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, the racing world's passion for taking on the global stage began to fizzle out overnight."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey. Can I stay here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, why is everyone so gloomy?
Is that Gase-mon thing really that bad?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...So Nakayama, are you aiming for the world stage in the end?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's still my goal even now.
Yeah, I'm still aiming for that even now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
People told you all sorts of things were impossible, right?
Why aim for what's impossible?
choice_data_list: Maybe that 'impossible' is just based on someone else's standards.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much others say it's impossible,
we still don't believe it is.
choice_data_list: By our standards, we can still do it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What are you two chatting so deeply about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...! Nakayama...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! There's one thing
I've been wanting to ask you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard you try, sometimes it's just pointless!
Nobody's watching, and nobody praises you anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There are so many times where everything you did ends up being completely pointless! Even so—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …………Can you really give it your all?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Same goes for you, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Kh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Taking reckless challenges isn't just struggling in vain.
It's preparing the ground for miracles to happen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Rather than struggling in vain,
I want to burn through this final light to the very end
so that no regrets remain.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...No matter what anyone says.
Rather than giving up and killing my heart,
I'll claw and struggle to survive, no matter how ugly it looks."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
……Aaargh, I don't get it!
Stop talking about such complicated stuff!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Living or whatever,
I seriously don't get it!!
...See ya!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...What was with that guy?
choice_data_list: I guess I just didn't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, City.
Do you know a good salon? For nails.
I want something cute, but tough-looking.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Your nails?
Then instead of a hospital,
wouldn't it be better to look for a salon?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No. Hos-pi-tal.
Um... take me there, please.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Before slathering on gel and trying to look cool,
I wanna fix what's actually broken.
